card.name: Endings of long drug and condition names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a long medical term, such as -ia in paresthesia, -INES in benzodiazepines, -in in norelgestromin, or -one in pioglitazone. It fires when the word is nearly finished and the next token starts a new word.

modes.label: Condition names ending -ia
modes.description: Final -ia of adverse-reaction terms like paresthesia or erythrodysesthesia.
modes.example: incidence of Grade 1 to 3 palmar-plantar erythrodysesthes<<ia>> syndrome was 7%.

modes.label: Drug class and drug names
modes.description: Closing piece of drug names or classes such as benzodiazepines, methemoglobinemia, norelgestromin, pioglitazone.
modes.example: CONCOMITANT USE WITH BENZODIAZEP<<INES>> OR OTHER CNS DEPRESSANTS

card.plain: It marks the point where a long drug or condition name has just been completed.
